header: Four things in every Desiderio package
subheadline: Open a row to see what each one does for your team. All four are in the free Community plan too.

items.title: Backend previews for all 244 elements
items.content: Every element shows a real preview in the TYPO3 page module. Editors can tell a hero from a pricing table without opening the record.

items.title: 15 theme presets you can switch live
items.content: Five presets from ui.shadcn.com/create and ten house presets, from Aurora to Midnight. Choose one in the site settings and the whole site changes.

items.title: Five switchable icon libraries
items.content: Lucide, Tabler, HugeIcons, Phosphor and Remix Icon, behind stable icon names. One setting changes the icon style of the whole site, with no content edits.

items.title: Optional integrations
items.content: Ready styling for News, Powermail, Apache Solr and the TYPO3 blog. Also included: 8 Form Framework forms with Friendly Captcha and a Brevo double opt-in newsletter finisher.
